/* selectBuyerMdAmCatalogCowayList */ SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER AS BUYER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND TYPE = 'ADCA' AND CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND CODE2 = A.BUYER AND FLAG = 'Y') AS BUYER_NAME, A.IMGFILE_NAME AS IMGFILE_NAME, A.IMGFILE_DIR AS IMGFILE_DIR, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, B.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, A.BUYER AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.DESCRIPTION_ENG, A.SPECIFICATION_ENG FROM ICOMBYIT A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N'
AND A.BUYER = #{st_com_code}
AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT CODE2 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND TYPE = 'ADCA' AND CODE1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y')
AND (UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION_LOC) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_description_loc} || '%') OR UPPER(A.DESCRIPTION_ENG) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_description_loc} || '%'))
AND (UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_specification_loc} || '%') OR UPPER(A.SPECIFICATION_ENG) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_specification_loc} || '%'))
AND UPPER(B.MAKER_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_maker_name} || '%')
AND UPPER(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%')
ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.BUYER
